macroModel.rateFormula: Weighted sum of each 3/6/12-month driver composite. Scores are model signals, not observed facts or market predictions.

drawdownModel.formula: Fund composite DD = 60% observed A PHP raw-NAV maximum drawdown + 40% forward-looking 10-year scenario median. Portfolio DD applies allocation weights and correlations.

slides.title: ATRAM Peso Money Market Fund - A PHP
slides.thesis: The required A PHP liquidity sleeve. It supplies rebalancing capital and risk capacity rather than the portfolio's primary growth.

slides.title: ATRAM Global Technology Feeder Fund - A PHP
slides.thesis: The required A PHP technology sleeve. Its long official NAV record replaces the prior unverified 44% proxy, and its target cost uses the disclosed A-ACC-USD TER.

slides.title: ATRAM Nasdaq Equity Income Feeder Fund - A PHP
slides.thesis: The required A PHP income/growth sleeve. Its short raw-NAV history is paired with a forward median; monthly distributions make the observed NAV drawdown conservative.

monitor.holding: ATRAM Peso Money Market Fund - A PHP
monitor.trigger: Investigate as not relevant if the verified net yield remains below the portfolio liquidity hurdle for two quarterly reviews, or the mandate/duration changes materially.
monitor.cadence: Daily source check; monthly yield review; quarterly mandate review

monitor.holding: ATRAM Global Technology Feeder Fund - A PHP
monitor.trigger: Investigate as not relevant if the target mandate drifts from global technology, verified all-in fees defeat the net forecast, or the 12-month technology signal remains below 3.0 while portfolio DD breaches its cap.
monitor.cadence: Daily source check; monthly macro/fee review; quarterly overlap review

monitor.trigger: Investigate as not relevant if technology exposure falls materially below the stated mandate, persistent earnings deterioration breaks the forward case, or concentration risk no longer earns its fee-adjusted return.
monitor.cadence: Monthly factsheet; quarterly holdings and mandate review

monitor.holding: ATRAM Nasdaq Equity Income Feeder Fund - A PHP
monitor.trigger: Investigate as not relevant if distribution or covered-call implementation changes materially, verified fees defeat the net forecast, or upside participation remains impaired without compensating income.
monitor.cadence: Daily source check; monthly distribution/volatility review; quarterly prospectus review

monitor.holding: JPM Nasdaq Equity Premium Income target ETF
monitor.trigger: Investigate as not relevant if the options overlay no longer supports income/volatility objectives, benchmark exposure drifts materially, or liquidity and tracking behavior deteriorate persistently.
monitor.cadence: Monthly ETF data; quarterly strategy and expense review
